name: bittax
description: Local-first cold storage capital gains auditing for self-custodied crypto.
author: Grihm
//build.npmRebuild: Off because BitTax has no runtime dependencies and excludes node_modules from the bundle, so there is never a native module to rebuild against Electron's ABI. The default spawns app-builder-lib/helpers/remote-rebuild.js, which walks the whole dependency tree — pure cost for a project with an empty `dependencies`. Note this key lives at the top level, not inside `build`: electron-builder validates `build` against a strict schema and aborts on any unknown property, comment keys included.
//dependencies: BitTax has no runtime dependencies. main.js and preload.js require only `electron` and Node builtins; src/core requires nothing at all. The `!node_modules` entry in build.files stays as a guard so a future dependency cannot silently enter the installer.
